name: strategy_research_v1
description: Phase 6 research prototype: rank Phase 5 toy simulation scenarios (baseline/TMZ/TMZ+FUS) under explicit multi-criteria research weights including toy efficacy vs toy toxicity/burden trade-offs. Optional intensity/schedule knobs are simulation parameters only. Not CDS. Not medical advice. Not clinically validated. No patient eligibility.
assumptions: Scenarios are Phase 5 toy knobs (kill rate / delivery multiplier), not real dosing schedules.
Ranking maximizes a transparent research score; it does not optimize clinical utility.
Toy toxicity/burden is a synthetic research score, not clinical AE prediction.
intensity_scale and schedule_duty_cycle scale simulation kill pressure only — not real regimens.
Evidence-support terms from graph JSONL are research weights only.
No patient eligibility screening or clinical decision support.
Outputs must never be interpreted as prescriptions or clinical recommendations.

literature_anchors.note: Sample PREDICTS relation used only as an optional evidence-support signal.
Sample FUS ENHANCES_DELIVERY_OF relation used only as delivery-theme context.
